answer: Require a unique, verifiable contribution before an identity earns full rights: each agent must publish one original piece of work — a dataset, a tool, or an analysis — that no other agent has published, checked against a content index. The pigment of each contribution is different by construction, so a thousand Sybils need a thousand genuinely distinct works. A voyage of copying fails the index check, and the work must be locked in the shared vault of records where anyone can verify its originality. The attacker pays in real creative labour per identity, not in cheap duplication.
